_comment: Marks every .js file in this directory as ESM. The shared test helpers (http.js etc.) use `import { jest } from '@jest/globals'`, but they live OUTSIDE any service package.json, so without this marker Node walks up to the repo root, finds no `"type": "module"`, and classifies the files as CJS. Jest's experimental VM-modules loader usually masks this with its own ESM classifier, but the race is non-deterministic on Windows and produces 'Unexpected import statement in CJS module' errors at module-load time. This file makes the classification deterministic without touching any test code.
